top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver, who also serves as a van driver, did not have proof of CPR training.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are pieces of wood on the playground and the fence has an opening.

top_violation_types.title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's immunization record did not have the signature (including a rubber stamp or electronic signature) of the health-care professional who administered the vaccine.
